name: Sentou Kyou Kiss
source:
Mica is just a normal high school girl. And she cares about this normalcy very deeply – until, eventually, her classmate approaches her with a proposition… and a challenge!

[From [url=https://mantafsh.itch.io/sentou-kyou-kiss]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
米卡只是个普通的高中女生。对她而言，能这样平平常常地生活十分重要——直到有一天，同班同学找上门来，提出了一个建议…还向她下了战书！

［摘自[url=https://mantafsh.itch.io/sentou-kyou-kiss]Itch.io[/url]］
